notes: The frozen row is chain-level with no locationId, so the verified boundary is Chili's US national menu rather than any one franchise or international menu.

restaurantLevelAllergenEvidence.statement: Chili's says menu items may contain or contact wheat, eggs, shellfish, tree nuts, milk, and other major allergens, and that common oil frying plus shared equipment and surfaces means no item can be guaranteed completely allergen-free.
Chili's asks guests with a food allergy to contact the restaurant to order and notify the team.

evidence.excerpt: The live Nutritionix special-diets catalog linked from Chili's official site returned 275 categorized US products. This unfiltered view supplies the complete current food and nonalcoholic product boundary.
The live Nutritionix 'contains milk' filter supplies direct item-level positive milk disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
The live Nutritionix 'contains egg' filter supplies direct item-level positive egg disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
The live Nutritionix 'contains fish' filter supplies direct item-level positive fish disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
The live Nutritionix 'contains gluten' filter supplies direct item-level positive gluten disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
The live Nutritionix 'contains soy' filter supplies direct item-level positive soy disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
The live Nutritionix 'contains shellfish' filter supplies direct item-level positive shellfish disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
The live Nutritionix 'contains peanut' filter supplies direct item-level positive peanut disclosures. Filter omission is not stored as an allergen-absence claim.
Current restaurant-controlled US menu exposes food, kids, sides and sauces, nonalcoholic beverages, and party platters and links the Nutrition Info service in its footer.
Chili's restaurant-controlled menu footer links this Chili's-branded Nutritionix landing page as NUTRITION INFO, establishing Nutritionix as the restaurant-linked nutrition/allergen vendor.
Chili's states at product level that menu items may contain or contact major allergens and that shared oil, equipment, and surfaces prevent a guarantee that items are allergen-free.
